reason: BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorage.java's javadoc (patch lines 245-249) says the provider dates from Keycloak 4.8.3 and should not need changes, yet the patch adds `var` (line 232) and RecoveryAuthnCodesCredentialModel branches in supportsCredentialType, updateCredential, isConfiguredFor, isValid and a new getCredentials override.
